QUOTE: NONE
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the library creates no threads and that mutex code is compiled out by default. It does describe `library/threading.c` as defining the mutex abstraction, but it never frames `library/` as supplying the mutex abstraction for threaded callers. Its main claim is that the library is lock-free by default and "nothing in the library is protected", so the second half of the contrast is not stated.
